description: The app layer (ADR 0265): the app's own screens in the main window, its own web view over the site (`webviews`, never the window, which the site shares). The first run and adding a server: the servers this app opens and their workspaces, what discovery found, the link waiting and a pair link's maker and workspace, choosing a server and signing in to agentes.chat (the main window opens there), help pages in the browser, running agentes.chat on this computer (setting it up and cancelling it, Tailscale's state for reach, opening or downloading Tailscale, and checking that an address of the person's own leads here, ADR 0265 §4). This computer's settings: Linux's Compatibility mode and reopening the app for it, the servers (the server here's reach and the phone's one-time sign-in made with the window's own session there, usage statistics, backups, start and stop, erase and start over), updates, this computer's folders, tools, activity (and a report of it, with this computer's system and size) and limits, its devices on its server with the main window's session (`site_fetch`: only those paths), pairing this computer with a workspace after the system's own dialog, this computer's essentials (`health_get`: open at login, the permissions, what keeps the server here up), and this Mac's permissions (their state, the system's prompts, the notifications' too, System Settings) with the setup kept so it comes back when macOS quits the app for Screen Recording. Its own place in the window: showing a screen, stepping aside, moving the site to one of its settings pages, dragging and zooming the window from its title bar.
